_note: Simulator settings. Fitted constants (home court, slope) are NOT here: they're fitted on 2025-26 games by `python -m tradesim.fit` and saved to data/model/fit.json.

player_value._replacement_bpm: Basketball-Reference's replacement level (the BPM used for VORP).
player_value._shrink_minutes: BPM is noisy in small samples, so each player's BPM is blended with replacement level as if he'd also played this many replacement-level minutes.

minutes._games_floor: Minutes per game = minutes / max(games, 20), so a player with a few garbage-time games doesn't look like a starter.
minutes._no_stats_mpg: Expected minutes for players with no 2025-26 stats (2026 draft picks by pick number; injured veterans use 'other').
